job.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A genuinely hand-drawn colored-pencil and light watercolor UI sprite for a cozy animal-rescue storybook mobile game. Image 1 controls canvas size and object shape ONLY. Image 2 shows the actual game yard for palette and mood ONLY; do NOT draw scenery. Fine warm gray-green pencil contours with slight human wobble and occasional double pencil strokes, visible short colored-pencil hatching, light watercolor pigment pooling on matte ivory drawing paper. Soft spring mint, warm cream and pale peach colors; restrained, cute, clean and readable at phone size. Flat graphic, absolutely no glossy gradient, no digital airbrushed glow, no 3D, no plastic bevels, no drop shadow. PURE WHITE #ffffff outside the object, clear closed silhouette for alpha extraction. No words, letters, numbers, logos or watermark. Draw EIGHT simple hand-drawn colored-pencil functional icons in exactly FOUR COLUMNS and TWO ROWS, evenly centered in equal square cells. TOP row left to right: two mint-green rounded pause bars; cream checklist sheet with three green ticks and tiny lines; a peach flower-shaped settings cog with small center hole; a cream house with muted green roof. BOTTOM row left to right: coral-pink animal paw print with four round toes and one rounded pad; a rounded mint-green play triangle; a sage musical eighth note; a pale sage speaker with two curved sound-wave marks. Each fills the central 48% of its cell. Fine warm gray-green pencil outlines, visible colored-pencil hatching and little watercolor wash, lovely handmade picture-book illustration, instantly recognizable silhouettes. No circular/square plates, backgrounds, shadow or labels. Pure white gaps between all icons.
job.negative: text, words, typography, numbers, watermark, screenshot, scenery, photorealistic, 3d, glossy, plastic, bevel, smooth digital gradient, airbrush, glowing outline, heavy black outline, dark brown frame, aged yellow parchment, distressed dirty paper, ripped edges, excessive ornaments, extra objects
